quizzes.question_text: Chef has 3 kilograms of sugar to distribute evenly among 15 desserts. How many grams of sugar will each dessert get?
solution: You want to find how many grams of sugar each dessert receives.
Chef starts with 3 kilograms of sugar. Note that there are 1000 grams in a kilogram, so multiply 3 kilograms by 1000 to get the amount of sugar in grams.
$3 \times 1000 = 3000$ grams
Now we know there are 3000 grams in total and there are 15 desserts. To find how many grams of sugar go into each dessert, we divide the amount of sugar by the number of desserts.
